selector.champion: Injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury
selector.rationale: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine and presence of cutaneous ulcers, woody induration, and contracture of muscles support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Scleroderma
rejected.why: Normal laboratory tests and lack of evidence for thrombosis or vasculitis contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Contracture and fibrosis
rejected.why: While contracture and fibrosis are present, they are more likely secondary to injectable drug use

rejected.label: Pancreatic panniculitis
rejected.why: Lack of pancreatic involvement and normal laboratory tests contradict this diagnosis
